shortDescription: Waits until an OpenWrt device is reachable/usable

options.name: connect_timeout
options.description: Maximum number of seconds to wait for a connection to happen before closing and retrying.

options.name: delay
options.description: Number of seconds to wait before starting to poll.

options.name: sleep
options.description: Number of seconds to sleep between checks.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Maximum number of seconds to wait for.
